device_qualifications.area: E11 / receiver reference and coupling: current copper versus function
device_qualifications.assessment: The latest owner report establishes an external VREF connection to U3 pin3, in addition to the already established pin5/VREF connection. It does not imply an internal connection between the two amplifier inputs. C19 lower joins C20 lower/D2.R/R28 right; C19 upper is GND. C20 upper joins R42 lower/D3.S. Thus C19 shunts the D2_C20 node to ground, while C20 couples that node to the R42/D3 junction; they are not parallel capacitors. At DC, C21/C22/C23 open and DNP R47/C42 remain absent. R26 (120 kohm) supplies negative feedback to U3.2; the R48 (5.6 kohm)-R25 (1.2 kohm) branch terminates through C23. Both resistor markings are 334 (330 kohm); the surface trace from R4 to PIC24/RB3 is visible in IMG_2436. The shared R3.2/R4.1/C28.1 junction remains unproved. The 10nF estimate gives a 1.65ms middle-node time constant with RB3 held low. GPIO/comparator timing or supply sensing is plausible, not a recovered function. Microchip Table 1-2 permits GPIO/ANB3/comparator use; ADC input range VSS..VDD and recommended source impedance at most 10 kohm prevent treating this as an automatically validated ADC divider. Preserve wiring and estimate; no new bench action.
